name: Intercos S.p.A.
summary: Intercos S.p.A., together with its subsidiaries, creates, produces, and markets cosmetics and skin care products worldwide. The company operates through Make Up, Skincare, and Hair & Body segments. It offers powders, foundation, lipsticks, mascara, nail polish, delivery systems, creams, serums, dermo cosmetic lotions, and hair care products. The company sells its products to multinational brands, emerging brands, and retailers. Intercos S.p.A. was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Agrate Brianza, Italy.
